business_type: cyclical grower (non-hyperscale AI infrastructure and integrated memory)
moat_source: systems-integration expertise and memory-attach relationships in non-hyperscale AI deployments; evidence: +104% AI revenue growth and beat-and-raise cadence, but hardware integration is a competitive, thin-moat trade (OM 13.4%)

returns.assumption_note: Convergence to scenario IV by year 5, ~60% of the gap closed by year 3.

sensitivity_key_driver: FY2027 growth delivery (the ~30% frame) against the Meta-transition drag
primary_model_risk: Growth mix transition: the raised guidance rides AI-infrastructure momentum while Advanced Computing shrinks 15-20% on the Penguin Edge wind-down and Meta exit. If the AI backlog converts slower than the legacy drag lands, FY2027's ~30% frame slips and the multiple (26x FY26 EPS) compresses toward hardware-peer levels.
expectations_gap_key_variable: FY2027 execution: at ~20x the FY2027 EPS frame the market modestly front-runs delivery; our base case applies a haircut for the Meta/Edge drag and lands ~19% below the price - a disagreement of degree, not kind
top_5_bull_arguments: Beat-and-raise quarter of the highest quality on this list relative to expectations (+48% revenue vs +12% originally guided for the year)
AI businesses at 74% of sales growing 104% y/y with backlog still building
~26x FY26 / ~20x FY27-frame EPS is the only sane growth multiple on this watchlist outside NVDA
Operating leverage visible: non-GAAP OM 13.4% from 11.9% despite gross-margin mix pressure
Small enough ($3.1B) that non-hyperscale AI infrastructure growth moves the needle for years
top_5_bear_arguments: Expected IV ($55.20) is ~19% below the price - the raise is already paid for
Gross margin fell 3.6pp y/y; AI-infrastructure mix is structurally lower-margin
Advanced Computing declining 15-20% (Penguin Edge wind-down, Meta exit) drags through FY2026-27
Dell/Supermicro/HPE competition caps pricing in every deal PENG wins
Beta 2.83 with same-day conflicting prints (-10.67%/+10.15%) - a thin tape that gaps on any guidance wobble
thesis_breakers: FY2027 growth frame walked back below 20%
AI-driven revenue growth decelerating below 50% y/y
